figures.label: Growth Rate
figures.source: The same notice sets the entry rules. A primary teacher needs a senior secondary pass with 50 percent, a two-year D.Ed. or B.El.Ed. and CTET Paper 1, a trained graduate teacher needs a bachelor's degree at 50 percent, a B.Ed. and CTET Paper 2, and a post graduate teacher needs a master's degree at 50 percent and a B.Ed.
